"""Small stats helpers."""


def median(nums):
    """Return the median of a list of numbers.

    For an odd-length list this is the middle element; for an even-length list
    it is the average of the two middle elements.
    """
    s = sorted(nums)
    n = len(s)
    if n % 2 == 1:
        return s[n // 2]
    return (s[n // 2 - 1] + s[n // 2]) / 2
